Hi Rohan —

Thanks — this is exactly the right time to sync. Below is a compact playbook we use for publisher activation and the minimum set of tenant proofs for the Azure technical gate. If you can provide these items we can queue you for a staging validation slot.

Minimum tenant proof checklist (what we need from Contoso):
1) Tenant ID and primary subscription ID (GUIDs)
2) Billing owner screenshot and billing account email (PDF/PNG)
3) Verified publisher contact (name + email + phone) for identity binding
4) SPN/service principal: preferred creation either by Contoso (recommended) or we can create via delegated SPN flow (we need RBAC contributor on subscription)
5) Manifest draft: contoso-manifest.json (we accept a minimal draft — SKU definitions + pricing type)
6) Evidence of regulatory/compliance boundaries if you're submitting Gov/sovereign offers (not needed for standard commercial)

Tech validation/runbook (high-level):
- Step 0: Confirm publish model (SaaS vs. VM vs. Azure App Service). Reply with selected model.
- Step 1: Provide tenant + subscription IDs and billing proof (we verify identity binding).
- Step 2: Exchange SPN details (client id, tenant id, object id) and confirm RBAC perms on subscription.
- Step 3: Upload manifest draft to our secure DocSend link and flag any private offers.
- Step 4: We run manifest lint + staging deploy (internal sandbox). Expect 24-48h for validation if all artifacts present.
- Step 5: If staging passes, schedule co-sell enablement and publisher publishing window (canary window).

A couple of clarifications:
- For SPN creation, if Contoso prefers creating the SPN, please create it and send the client id + cert/secret via our secure transfer link (do not send secrets over email).
- If you have an existing ARM template for the SKU, include it; otherwise we can validate with a minimal manifest.

Cc'ing Marissa who will coordinate the co-sell paperwork once the technical gate is green.

Olga
Senior Partner Technical Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks Rohan / Olga — quick technical notes from the runtime/validation side. I'm the engineer who will own the staging deploy — a few specifics to avoid surprises: 

1) SPN permissions: we only need Contributor role on the subscription scope for staging validation. If you prefer least privilege, we can validate with Microsoft.AppPlatform/* and Microsoft.Resources/deployments/* but Contributor is faster.

2) Token/secret handoff: use the secure upload link Olga shared. If you must share a one-time secret, create a secret that expires in 7 days.

3) Manifest: include these keys so our linter can run successfully: skuId, skuName, publishType, pricingModel, endpointType, supportUrl. Example line: "pricingModel": "metered" or "flat".

4) Staging tenant: please provide the tenant GUID and an e-mail that has Owner rights so we can run automated smoke tests. We spin up a small instance and run connectivity + identity binding checks.

5) Packaging: for SaaS offers we prefer a containerized deployment with health probes. If you are providing VM images, include an ARM template and a snapshot link.

If you send the tenant id + manifest by EOD tomorrow I can reserve a staging run on Monday (2026-08-09).
